iframe.style: position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:none; margin:0; padding:0; overflow:hidden; z-index:999999; display:none;

h1.style: font-size:36px; font-weight:700; color:#fff; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-1px; margin:0;

p.style: color:#8888aa; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:4px; text-transform:uppercase; margin:8px 0 0 0; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;

div.style: display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:100vh; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; color:#8888aa;
display:none; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap:20px; max-width:1400px; margin:0 auto; padding:20px 20px 40px;
